summary.implementedScope: Implemented Story 5 by adding public runtime-change event types, closed payload validation, typed message projection, and verbatim turn-composition placement for model/thinking-level changes.
summary.acceptanceRationale: Story-lead scoped acceptance is ready for impl-lead review and outer acceptance.

changedFiles.reason: Added model_change and thinking_level_change to MessageEventInput.
Added event kinds and structured payload validation for previous/new model and thinking-level fields.
Extended BlockType with typed runtime-change block types.
Projected runtime-change events into typed blocks with structured fields instead of text runtime notes.
Extended RenderingPartKind and RenderingPart shape so typed runtime blocks can be carried through turn composition.
Placed typed runtime-change messages as non-derived components in stream order with original typed block content preserved.
Classified runtime-change events as non-transition events like runtime_note.
Handled new message kinds in tail rendering exhaustively.
Handled new message kinds in stored-member concat fallback exhaustively.
Handled new block types in message edit block dispatch exhaustively.
Added default fixture payloads for new runtime-change event kinds.
Updated fixture kind/key coverage for new event kinds.
Added Story 5 tests for typed projection and verbatim ordered turn placement.
